verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a command-line tool, and its docs show conversion run as a local command on local files. Community users describe running it on their own machines, including local GPU encoding and batch wrappers. However, the evidence contains no vendor statement that files are never uploaded or that processing stays offline, so only the local-execution half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor no-upload/privacy statement, and explicit documentation that conversion runs fully offline.

support.subject: As a power user, conversion runs entirely on my machine, and the vendor states that files are never uploaded

citations.quote: A complete, cross-platform solution to record, convert and stream audio and video.
User chops large videos with FFmpeg and loves how fast it is.
